images: Required for all 100 tasks and transported as native model image blocks; no no-image control.
metric: Only pinned upstream binary score_exact. Every attempted task in denominator; missing or invalid answers are zero.
look: First precommitted qualification look n=100 under qualification/protocol.json; Wilson 98.333333% and paper-cluster bootstrap if valid paper IDs exist.
stop: Stop remaining gates on conclusive accuracy failure; otherwise continue at prespecified looks subject to finite population 142.
verifier_audit: Before qualification, separately measure false acceptance of known-wrong perturbations and false rejection of independently equivalent/correct values; do not infer from solver accuracy.
